runners.comment: Runner-up at Newbury in December on second handicap start and he's one to consider
runners.name: Im A Lumberjack
runners.spotlight: Maiden/novice hurdle winner (2m5f/2m3f, good to soft) who was runner-up at Newbury (2m4f, good) in December on his second handicap start; could continue to improve and he's one to consider.

runners.comment: Returned from long absence with pretty encouraging run and he has a good record here

runners.spotlight: 10yo who returned from a long absence with a pretty encouraging fourth at Haydock in December; he's well treated on his old form and his form figures at Doncaster read 211, the wins coming on good/good to soft; interesting.

runners.comment: Third at Taunton four weeks ago and he might not be far away if he's on another going day
runners.name: Bluegrass
runners.spotlight: Inconsistent but he's won over hurdles five times (soft-good) and returned to form when third at Taunton (2m3f, good) four weeks ago; he might not be far away if he's on another going day.

runners.comment: Won on debut in March 2024; interesting to see how he goes in betting on first run since
runners.name: Huffin An A Puffin
runners.spotlight: 10-1 when winning on debut at Newbury (2m4f, good to soft) in March 2024 for Harry Derham; absent since and needs to prove he retains that promise but it will be interesting to see how he goes in the betting on his handicap/stable debut (remains in the same ownership).

runners.comment: Back on song when runner-up at Musselburgh last month and could be in the shake-up
runners.name: Smokeringinthedark
runners.spotlight: Things have been up and down since he won on his rules debut at Musselburgh (2m4f, good to soft) in December 2024 but this lightly raced 6yo was back on song when runner-up there (2m4f, good to soft) last month; could be in the shake-up if conditions aren't an issue (unproven on soft).

15:00.race_name: Virgin Bet Novices' Handicap Chase (Go North Forgive 'N Forget Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Runner-up at Uttoxeter on New Year's Eve following long absence and there's lots to like
runners.name: Mumfords Magic
runners.spotlight: 8yo who is 0-8 under rules but has finished second on two of his three chase starts, most recently at Uttoxeter (2m4f, good to soft) on New Year's Eve following a long absence; shaped last time as though he would appreciate this step back up in trip; also effective on soft; lots to like.

runners.breeder: Joel Denis Clotilde De Barmon Emmanuel
runners.comment: He's left his hurdle form well behind since switched to fences and holds solid claims

runners.breeder: E A R L Ecurie Des Mottes
runners.comment: 3m point winner who is open to improvement now upped in trip and he's one to consider
runners.name: Kadjar Des Mottes
runners.spotlight: Challenging when falling two out on chase debut at Sedgefield (2m5f, soft) in November and he kept on for fourth at Musselburgh (2m4f, good to soft) in December; this 3m point winner is open to improvement now stepped up in trip and he could have a part to play.

runners.comment: Promising novice hurdler in 2021-22 but absent since February 2023; probably best watched
runners.name: Flemenstide
runners.spotlight: Promising novice hurdler for Paul Nicholls in 2021-22 season; however, below par in winter 2022-23 and sold for £2,000 in June 2023; absent since and this 11yo is probably best watched on today's chase/stable debut.

runners.breeder: Sca La Perrigne D Powell Et Al
runners.comment: On a handy mark but struggled towards the end of last year; returns after wind surgery
runners.name: Halpha Soleil
runners.spotlight: Runner-up at Hexham (2m4f, good to soft) last May and runs off 8lb lower today; however, he struggled on his four starts towards the end of last year; major turnaround required on first run since wind surgery.

15:35.race_name: Virgin Bet Handicap Chase (Go North Monet's Garden Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Ran well in two of his first three chases and is eased slightly in grade today; big player
runners.name: Gentleman Bill
runners.spotlight: Made promising seasonal/chase debut in October and bounced back from a lesser effort when third in first-time cheekpieces at Wetherby (2m3f, soft) on Boxing Day; eased slightly in grade today; high on the list.

runners.comment: Ran well on both outings this season (2m4f/3m); tried in cheekpieces today
runners.name: Busty Boy
runners.spotlight: Thorough stayer who coped well with drop back to 2m4f when close second on seasonal debut at Carlisle (good) in October and also ran well when third at Ayr (3m, soft) in November, albeit his finishing effort was a bit disappointing; back in trip again here and tried in cheekpieces; shortlisted.

runners.comment: Placed on seasonal/chase debut; contender if able to rebound from last month's poor run
runners.name: The Winslow Boy
runners.spotlight: Quite lightly raced 7yo who was placed on seasonal/chase debut at Chepstow (2m, good) in November; ran no race at Hereford last month but has possibilities if back on song here.

runners.comment: Out of form this season but suited by this track and too well handicapped to rule out
runners.name: William Of York
runners.spotlight: Pulled up on first two appearances this season and finished behind Gentleman Bill when never-dangerous sixth at Wetherby (2m3f, soft) on Boxing Day; suited by this track, though, and too well handicapped to rule out.

runners.comment: 2-7 over hurdles; open to more improvement over today's longer trip and over fences
runners.name: Another Fine Mess
runners.spotlight: Pipped a next-time-out winner to score over hurdles at Chepstow (2m, good to soft) just after Christmas and is now 2-7 in that sphere; open to more improvement over today's longer trip and over fences; looks interesting on chase debut.

runners.comment: Well beaten on both starts for new stable this season (hurdle/chase)
runners.name: Clonakilty
runners.spotlight: Well handicapped on old form for Olly Murphy but well beaten on both starts for new stable this season (hurdles/chase); needs to turn a corner.

runners.comment: Dug deep to make winning chase debut here in December; not suited by Taunton last time
runners.name: Cuban Court
runners.spotlight: Three-time hurdle winner who dug deep to score on chase debut here (2m, good to soft) in December, having made a bad jumping error in the early stages; didn't fire at Taunton last month (reportedly unsuited by the track) but this move back up in trip ought to suit and his current mark is workable.

runners.comment: Second to progressive subsequent winner at Newcastle last month; only 1lb higher here
runners.name: Empty Nest
runners.owner: M Blades S Morrell K Hathaway
runners.spotlight: Dual chase winner who returned to form with pretty good second behind progressive subsequent winner at Newcastle (2m4f, good to soft) last month; nudged up only 1lb for that run and can make presence felt again here.

runners.comment: Back from long absence with a win at Haydock but was never involved at Windsor next time
runners.name: Lets Go To Vegas
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 8yo who returned from long absence with narrow win at Haydock (2m3f, good to soft) in December but was never dangerous in her follow-up bid at Windsor (fourth of eighth) last month; that wasn't a bad effort but she needs to find more to defy this mark.

runners.comment: Placed in five of her six hurdle runs and she's respected on handicap debut
runners.name: October Hill
runners.spotlight: Overall record of 0-9 but she's been placed in five of her six hurdle runs, including when third of 13 in a Taunton maiden (2m3f, good to soft) last month; that was a good effort behind an improver last time and she's respected on handicap debut.

runners.comment: Won Wetherby maiden and that form has been boosted recently; interesting on handicap debut
runners.name: Scavengers Reign
runners.spotlight: Made it fourth time lucky over hurdles with a comfortable win in big-field maiden at Wetherby (2m3f, soft; 11-10 favourite) on Boxing Day; that form has been boosted by the runner-up recently and this unexposed mare is 4lb well in on this handicap debut; interesting contender.

runners.comment: Won on hurdling debut in 2024; not seen since but she needs watching in market on comeback
runners.name: Pure Seduction
runners.spotlight: Bought for £30,000 after making the frame in two Irish points; well held in sole bumper but she won on hurdling debut at Worcester (2m, good) in August 2024; has been on the sidelines since but she now goes handicapping at this new trip and needs watching in market on her comeback.

runners.comment: No joy over fences this winter but she needs watching in market back over hurdles
runners.name: I Am The Moon
runners.spotlight: No joy in two chase runs (unseated/well held) this winter, but she was promising as a novice hurdler last season including a front-running win at Warwick (2m3f, good to soft); still has potential and she needs watching in market back in this sphere.

runners.comment: Lightly raced 10yo who has struggled since winning a maiden hurdle in 2022; opposable
runners.name: Rock On Cassie
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 10yo; won a maiden hurdle (2m4f, yielding) for Gordon Elliott in 2022 but she's struggled since and was pulled up on stable debut at Uttoxeter in December; bled from the nose last time and she was also reported to have an irregular heartbeat.

runners.comment: Not lasting out over 2m4f latterly; slow ground no issue but mark could be lower ideally.
runners.name: A Mere Bagatelle
runners.spotlight: Not the only one for whom the drop back in trip looks advisable on recent evidence, and although still winless on soft or worse, he does act on ground this slow; remains above any mark ever defied, however.

runners.breeder: Razza Del Sole Societa Agricola Srl
runners.comment: Career-best RPR on December's return from a long absence; may pay to forgive last time.

runners.comment: Ran right up to mark in a better, longer race here latest (soft); turn is surely nearing.
runners.name: Raffles Nobu
runners.spotlight: Now 22lb lower than for his British debut a year ago, finally shaping as if down to a mark he could win off when 6l fourth over an extended 2m3f here last month (soft); this race looks a fair bit easier.

runners.comment: Third on two of last three starts, without quite lasting home; return to 2m worth a try.
runners.name: Ask Peter
runners.spotlight: Close third at Ludlow three runs ago (2m5f, good) came in a falsely run affair; didn't really last out over shorter at Taunton on Tuesday, but ability definitely lurks and this return to 2m looks the way to go for now.

runners.comment: C&D winner on heavy in late 2022; return to form switched to front-running tactics latest.
runners.name: Tommy Dillion
runners.spotlight: Deep ground and a strong pace to aim at proved just the ticket when landing another C&D 0-105 in December 2022; interesting to see what tactic is employed today, a rare crack at front-running having got him back on track at Fontwell latest.

runners.breeder: D A Hunt And A T Huckfield
runners.comment: Return to 2m makes sense; over five years since her last win outside mares-only company.
runners.name: Sawpit Sienna
runners.spotlight: Not lasting out over longer trips this term, so return to 2m makes sense, but it's over five years since she was last able to win outside mares-only company; 6lb out of the weights.

runners.comment: Shaped well for a fair way in a Warwick maiden hurdle latest (2m5f); remains of interest.

runners.spotlight: The only horse to beat the subsequently prolific El Capitaine in eight points, and although yet to hit the line hard in either of his starts under rules (too free on first of those) he did shape well for a fair way in a Warwick maiden hurdle latest (2m5f, good to soft); remains of interest.

runners.comment: Unable to break out of rear on either start; looks one for moderate handicaps after this.

runners.spotlight: Unable to break out of rear on either start (2m2f/2m) and already appears more likely to find his level in modest handicaps.

runners.breeder: J R Hales & Miss L J Hales
runners.comment: Out of a sister to the useful Theatrical Star; may have something to offer at this trip.

runners.spotlight: £1,000 buy last May but encouragement on paper, being a half-brother to a few 2m3f-3m1f jumps scorers out of a Listed hurdles-winning sister to the useful Theatrical Star; missed recent bumper engagement on soft ground.

runners.spotlight: Subject of a running and riding inquiry after a 54l defeat at Uttoxeter latest (2m, soft) but he's essentially shaping as in need of more time at present and others are more compelling; hood added.

runners.comment: Clear with one other for his taking Irish point win last March; £305,000 sale soon after.

runners.spotlight: Poet's Word gelding out of a multiple staying hurdle winner; bought for £305,000 soon after an Irish point win for Stuart Crawford last March (3m, yielding to soft; front pair clear) and given plenty of time since; player starting at a realistic level, assuming 2m isn't too sharp.

runners.comment: Latest fifth place was another improved effort; more needed but no forlorn place hope.

runners.spotlight: Improvement with each start, again finishing fifth last time at Leicester (1m7f, heavy) but seeing it out better and beaten less far; more needed again but no forlorn place hope.

runners.comment: Solid 15l third on last month's hurdling debut despite not settling; capable of better.

runners.spotlight: Handled soft okay at the first time of asking on last month's Hereford hurdling debut (2m, soft; beaten 15l), a refusal to settle simply catching him up late; upgrades that effort here if helping himself more.

runners.comment: Forced a share of second on British/bumper debut; drop to 2m may not rate a plus though.

runners.comment: Two heavy defeats (one C&D) to show for last year's belated start to her racing career.

runners.name: Officer Of State

runners.name: Sherborne

runners.comment: Found 2m7f too taxing last month; player if judged on clear second over 2m4f in December
runners.name: Koenigsstern

runners.comment: Offered little over C&D on latest comeback, albeit in a 0-120; quite a bit more is needed.

runners.comment: 4211 in handicaps here; soundly beaten at Sedgefield yesterday.

runners.comment: Career-best form when second at Market Rasen before pulling up behind Osterberg latest.

runners.spotlight: Mixed signals as regards his optimum trip this term, though still able to post career-best form in defeat at Market Rasen at Christmas; hung left when pulling up behind Osterberg latest, however.

runners.comment: Second in dramatic Fontwell race latest; reproduction of slow-ground best won't suffice.
runners.name: Atlantic Power

runners.comment: Yet to demonstrate much ability remains since returning from well over three years out.
runners.name: High Grounds

runners.comment: Beaten an aggregate of 120l by Getaway With You in two runs here before Christmas (2m3f).
runners.name: Engaging Sam
runners.spotlight: Beaten an aggregate of 120l by Getaway With You in two runs here before Christmas (2m3f); it's hard to be confident that this longer trip is a plus.

runners.comment: In process of running well before mishap on seasonal debut; well beaten since, though
runners.name: Desert Halo

runners.comment: C&D winner; below form over 2m4f last time but had begun this season with two good 2m runs
runners.name: Bobbis Beauty
runners.spotlight: Three chase wins, one over C&D on soft; below form over 2m4f at Warwick on New Year's Eve but had begun this season with two good efforts over 2m (one here) and can make a bold bid from the front if back on song.

runners.comment: C&D winner in 2024; returned from one-year absence with two disappointing runs this term
runners.name: Angels Dream
runners.spotlight: Now 3lb lower than when clinging on by a neck over C&D (soft) in November 2024 but returned from one-year absence with two disappointing runs this season (cheekpieces added last time) and needs to prove his wellbeing.

runners.name: El Rojo Grande

runners.spotlight: Bang-in-form 9yo who bids for a hat-trick after recent wins at Market Rasen (2m1f, soft) and Ffos Las (2m, heavy); avoids penalty for latter success and is 6lb ahead of the handicapper; makes obvious appeal.

runners.comment: Out of form over hurdles this season; considered only if lively in betting on chase debut
runners.name: Chosen Bae
runners.spotlight: Made a winning handicap hurdle debut off today's mark at Bangor (2m3f, soft) a year ago but safely held on all six starts this season; considered only if lively in the betting before this chasing debut.

runners.name: Moyowasi

runners.name: Roaring Ralph
runners.spotlight: Acts well on this surface, having won over 7f here and at Wolverhampton; arrives in solid form, having been second here over both 7f and this trip on his last two starts; player.

runners.name: Amarachi
runners.spotlight: 6f turf winner; runner-up over C&D on her last two starts; no change to her mark and should be thereabouts again.

runners.comment: Step back in the right direction at Lingfield (1m, Polytrack) last time; each-way player.
runners.name: Volendam
runners.spotlight: 0-13 (placed over C&D); arrives following a step back in the right direction at Lingfield (1m, Polytrack) last time; each-way player.

runners.name: Law Degree

runners.spotlight: 0-15; went close to breaking her duck at Newcastle (6f, Tapeta) in November, when 4lb higher; inconsistent and arrives with a little bit to prove after finishing last back at Newcastle (7f) latest.

runners.name: War Memorial

runners.comment: Unplaced; slipping towards a basement mark as a result of that but needs to show more.
